reference.transcript: I'm sure you've seen videos like this go viral all the time. These are podcast videos from YouTube trimmed into short film content and they just keep going viral. The secret? They actually use AI. Go to clap.app, paste your YouTube link, choose your caption style, set the dimensions, and hit generate shorts. In just a few minutes, you'll have multiple shorts fully trimmed with captions ready to upload. It also gives you the summary, transcript, and even the virality score to help you pick the clips with the best chance of going viral. Wow! To generate your clips that really go viral, you've got to choose the podcast clip that's intriguing and hits on the hot topic this season. Now, this tool isn't free but if you see the potential to monetize your content, it's definitely worth trying out. Comment the word clap if you found this helpful and I'll see you in the next one.

styleProfile.summary: A tutorial-style short-form video where a host demonstrates how to use an AI tool (clap.app) to convert long-form YouTube podcast videos into viral short-form clips. The video features screen recordings of the software interface, showing the process of pasting a link, generating clips, and reviewing virality scores, intercut with the host speaking directly to the camera.

captionStyle.notes: Captions are centered on the screen, using a clean sans-serif font. Some text overlays like 'from YouTube' use brand colors.

structure.purpose: Show a viral example to grab attention
Screen record the AI tool usage
Show the virality score and summary features
Call to action and sign off
